reviews.review:
I would argue one of the best indie roguelikes of all time and can give your computer graphics card a work out if you tweak the settings. The wide variety of items allow a large number of wacky combinations providing a number of ways to play for each and every character. With the ability to add artifacts and change up characters and play with friends this is also a great and it handles inconsistent wifi better than almost any other party games I've played.

For even more fun try out adding mods with Rainfusion to push the game even farther. Overall this game is a blast and it being a 2D platformer allows item combinations that would break 3D games.
can be far more unforgiving than its sequel but otherwise pretty good

Initially I hated this game, because I didn't understand it. It felt like I was much too slow, and the enemies were just bullet sponges. But after watching a couple of videos of others playing, and see how they play, I gave it another shot, and eventually beat the game the first time with the first character. A good experience.

After a while I ended up getting some relics and new characters. For me, the best of the game comes when you get and start using the 'Sacrifice' relic. I spent just over an hour on the first level killing mobs with the unlocked 'Huntress' character and got so many items I became an unstoppable killing machine. Elite mobs and even bosses were going down left and right, all the way until the final boss.

I was able to get every achievement in my 23 hours playing, and had some good times in those hours.

Two huge cons:
1. The advertised co-op play may as well be a lie. To set up co-op is such a hassle and unstable that me and the people I was going to play with didn't even end up doing it. Do not play this expecting to have a good time with your friends. If co-op worked like it ought to, and does in any other game, it would be such a great time, but it doesn't.
2. Crashes. I had 2 crashes in my time of playing, both on the same day. I was 62 minutes into a great run when I got the first crash. Sure it 'only' happened twice but that really is inexcusable. My final run where I got my last achievement I played for about 80 minutes. Everything ran smoothly, but damn if I wasn't terrified of the game crashing. The worry definitely lowered my enjoyment.

The game and gameplay really is great and very satisfying, but it may take a while to understand it properly to be able to enjoy it.

I've had this game for quite awhile and I figured with the second game being out for a couple years now, I should show this some more love and write a little about how I love it.

My friend and I have played quite a few rogue-likes/lites and we've found that we don't like a lot of them for a few reasons.  One of the reasons that I don't like some of them is the fact that they limit your power in the game.  Take Wizard of Legend, for example.  I think that game is interesting, but you never get to break the game like you can in Binding of Isaac.  We compare most roguelites to Isaac, actually.  That isn't to say that you have to be able to "break" the game in order to have a fun time (there are plenty of underpowered difficult runs that are really memorable and fun), but allowing the player to find a synergy and let them run wild with it can be really fun.
This is one of the reasons I love Risk of Rain.  The synergies are almost meant to be broken, but you can still have fun without doing so.  Do you want to stack 15 fireworks and kill everything on screen whenever you open something?  Yeah, that works.  I feel like there aren't many games that let you do that.

Another point is that this game runs very well.  Obviously it's not the biggest game and graphically it's not doing a whole lot, but its aesthetic is very appealing along with the great music.  Still, even with 800 things happening onscreen, the game does run really well.  That's always a plus.  It will start to struggle at a point, but the amount of stuff going on in order for that to happen and how long into a run you are, you're already ready for the run to be over by that point imo.

Anyway, love the game.  I have bought it twice now on Steam and PS4, lol.  Suggest it to anyone who likes this sort of stuff.  I think it's probably the best of it's kind.
